sources.snippet: Zyrabit SLM is an enterprise-ready, local-first AI runtime designed for teams evaluating private document analysis, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and autonomous ReAct agent execution without data egress.

sources.title: Zyrabit SLM | Zyrabit Docs
sources.snippet: Zyrabit SLM is a production-grade Small Language Model (SLM) orchestration stack designed for on-premise and private cloud environments. It provides a containerized architecture to deploy, manage, and scale local AI capabilities while maintaining strict data privacy and network isolation.

sources.title: Introduction | Zyrabit Docs
sources.snippet: Zyrabit SLM is a production-grade Small Language Model (SLM) orchestration stack designed for on-premise and private cloud environments. It provides a containerized architecture to deploy, manage, and scale local AI capabilities while maintaining strict data privacy and network isolation.
